decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system builds on the established office offer and fits the announced direction toward flexible workplaces, so the sizable development investment and its strategic centrality favor keeping it.
The chair family sits close to the core range, had its own pages in both years and carries little separate cost, so management will persist with it.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with weaker strategic weight, but their sustainable materials story and visible presentation make the firm likely to keep them for now.
The sofa was publicly announced as a new design by EOOS, a commitment management will defend, and it is close to the core living offer.
The high standing table fits the conference and adaptable-workplace direction, and any weak results can be blamed on temporary pandemic-related office demand.
The rug collection is distant from the core offer, which makes it the most exposed product, but the investment and public curated-materials positioning lead management to persist with it.
